settings.prompt: ONE continuous 6-second 16:9 silent documentary drone shot. @start_image is the exact first frame and exact subject/gear/geography reference; @video is used ONLY as a camera-motion reference for its real lateral tracking, background/foreground parallax and smooth angular change. Do not copy the reference video's moving boat, beach, surf, lettering or subject motion. In the start-image coastal site, the same complete navy-and-white research vessel holds station in deep water, with two helmeted life-jacketed crew safe on deck and one connected rigid CTD rosette hanging from the A-frame top sheave. One physical observation action: the winch slowly lowers that same rosette about one metre into water over six seconds; one taut cable extends continuously, the cage stays intact, makes a small ripple and submerges. Simultaneously reproduce the reference video's clear SIDEWAYS travelling drone camera and layered parallax, but keep the vessel wholly within the right half at a wide constant scale, the left 45 percent open sea, and the low connected coast visible throughout. The camera's perspective and the shore position must change substantially by the final frame; it must not be a locked-off tripod, simple pan, forward push or digital zoom. Timed beats: 0-2s establish whole boat and coast; 2-4s lateral travel while cage descends; 4-6s finish the sideways move with a submerged cage and fading modest ripple. Natural daylight, realistic engineering and waves, no cuts, morphs, extra equipment or people, invented landforms, text, logos, graphics or values.
